one_line_description.quote: Bring your support team, customer data, workflows, and AI Agent together in one platform built for every stage of the customer journey.

has_public_api.quote: The Gorgias REST API lets you read and write data in your helpdesk programmatically.

api_type.quote: The Gorgias API is structured with REST in mind.

api_breadth.value: REST, read-write helpdesk resources (tickets, customers, accounts, etc.); full endpoint count not documented in captured sources
api_breadth.quote: On this page, you'll find the complete REST API reference, examples, definitions of objects, and guides.

docs_url.quote: Explore our guides and technical documentation to integrate with Gorgias.

auth_methods.quote: Please remember that the API key authentication method can be used only for private apps. If you plan to build a public app you have to use OAuth2.

access_model.quote: - Available on all Helpdesk plans - The account owner and admins can access the API credentials and create API keys

access_notes.value: API is available on any Helpdesk plan with no API-specific tier, but a Gorgias helpdesk account is required; the account owner or an admin must create the API key in Settings → REST API. Private apps need no approval; public apps require Developer Portal signup plus App Store review.
access_notes.quote: - Available on all Helpdesk plans - The account owner and admins can access the API credentials and create API keys

official_mcp_server.quote: The setup process varies by client, but the connection URL is the same: https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp

rate_limits.value: 80 requests per 20-second window for OAuth2 apps; 40 requests per 20-second window for API key integrations; Enterprise accounts have the same limits in a 10-second window
rate_limits.quote: - OAuth2 apps can make 80 requests in a 20 second window - API key integrations can make 40 requests in a 20 second window - Enterprise accounts folow the same request limits, but have a smaller 10-second window

webhooks.quote: To receive information from tickets and new messages sent from Gorgias, you will have to create an endpoint for the HTTP integration to call.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Captured docs state undocumented resources can be changed or removed at any time without prior notice; a formal API versioning/deprecation policy was not captured.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: Resources, resources' attributes, and resources' operations not documented in this documentation should not be used and should be considered as non-existing. They are reserved for internal use and can be changed or removed at any time without prior notice.

verdict_reason: Gorgias exposes a documented REST API with self-serve API keys for private apps and OAuth2 for public apps. Credentials nevertheless require a Gorgias helpdesk account on a Helpdesk plan and an owner/admin user, while public apps also need Developer Portal signup and App Store review. The API is broad enough for useful support actions, but the account/plan gate and review path make it moderate rather than easy.
main_blocker: Requires a paid Gorgias Helpdesk account to generate API keys
open_questions: An OAuth2 scopes page (developers.gorgias.com/docs/oauth2-scopes) appears in the search index but was not included in SOURCES; confirm whether scopes are formally documented.
No official vendor-maintained SDKs were found in the cited sources; verify whether any exist.
The captured pricing evidence does not conclusively show whether any free Helpdesk tier exists; if one does, access_model could be self_serve_free.
No dedicated API sandbox/test environment is documented in SOURCES; the only testing guidance found is issuing requests from the API reference with real keys.
The REST API endpoint/resource count is not documented in the captured sources, so api_breadth is approximate.
